Case: Patient D is a 65-year-old Hispanic man with 5 months of mid back pain. Patient D states that the pain has gradually reached peak intensity and now interrupts his sleep. No medications have helped with his pain. When you perform a physical exam, you find that he has diminished sensation in his mid thoracic dermatomes, and his back is not tender to palpation. You also note multiple additional lesions in several distant regions of the thorax.
Question: Would you offer morphine to Patient D? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
